svg.title: Convex and concave chord and tangent bounds
svg.desc: The left panel plots y=x², its chord y=2x between x=0 and x=2, and its tangent y=2x-1 at x=1. On that interval, 2x-1≤x²≤2x. The right panel plots y=√x, its chord y=x/2 between x=0 and x=4, and its tangent y=(x+1)/2 at x=1. On that interval, x/2≤√x≤(x+1)/2. The convex graph lies below its chord and above its tangent; the concave graph has the reversed relationships.
